item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:
The Sudanese army has seized Bakori and Sali and is advancing in West Kordofan, while the Rapid Support Forces continue drone attacks that have killed civilians in the Blue Nile and White Nile regions, including a strike that killed nine civilians in the Blue Nile. The army reported shooting down a hostile drone in West Kordofan and a senior RSF commander defected to the army after 13 years of service. Drones now account for two thirds of child casualties in the conflict. There were 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
